title: Open-Source AI Dance & Douyin/TikTok Choreography Music Catalog

repositories.name: FineDance (ICCV 2023) — HuggingFace MotionHub Mirror
repositories.paper_title: FineDance: A Fine-grained Choreography Dataset for 3D Full Body Dance Generation
repositories.license_note: Academic & Open Research Dataset (211 songs, 22 dance genres, 48kHz WAV slices)
repositories.lossless_reconstruction_trick: Slices are 12.0s long with a 6.0s sliding window step (mean_abs_diff = 0.00 at shift=6.0s). Concatenating even slices (slice_0 + slice_2 + slice_4) reconstructs bit-exact 36.0s master WAV tracks.

repositories.name: AIST++ & AIST Dance Video Database (Google & AIST Japan)
repositories.paper_title: AI Choreographer: Music Conditioned 3D Dance Generation with AIST++ (ICCV 2021)
repositories.license_note: 60 copyright-cleared original studio dance tracks across 10 street/pop dance genres (80–135 BPM).

repositories.name: PopDanceSet / POPDG (CVPR 2024 Popular & Youth Dance Dataset)
repositories.paper_title: POPDG: Popular 3D Dance Generation with PopDanceSet (CVPR 2024)
repositories.license_note: Curated trending pop/idol/ACG dance clips from Bilibili & Douyin.
